scope: Practical usability: explicit startup, retained offscreen scene, visible desktop/mobile navigation, presets and user-selected quality. Existing M7 scene geometry preserved; no further art-detail iteration.
visualPolicy: User says sufficient visual quality is enough; photoreal equivalence and 60fps are optional future work, not this usability release gate. No claim of individual visual signoff for every view.
changes: No automatic heavy iframe launch on page open or scroll; only explicit start.
Only one GPU world; offscreen retains document and pauses drawing; active generation may continue until stopped.
Always-present navigation supports four view presets, six translation and four look directions, press/release, blur/cancel/offscreen safety and manual collapse.
Smooth default: 75% linear canvas, 2048 shadow and 512 reflection; clear: full canvas, 4096 shadow and 1024 reflection. Full geometry and plants retained.
Existing capture temporarily uses clear quality and restores user quality/pose; complete 45-second export not repeated this iteration.

verification.smallViewport: Child DOM bounds/no-overflow and same document/context verified at resized parent width550. Whole-parent screenshot missed Li due responsive page reflow; not a phone/device or visual mobile signoff.
